explication: This repository is an actively curated AI engineering resource collection, with weekly evidence-backed review and a README validator. The main user workflow is browsing resources to learn foundations, build AI systems, and work with coding agents. README sections also cover evaluation, observation, and deployment. The tree shows curation prompts and schemas, but their implementation and wiring were not sampled; those relationships are therefore not inferred.
